name: ability_builder
description: Build anything as a new /command and manage its versions
usage: /build <what you want>; /abilities

name: agents
description: Parallel specialists with a reviewed text deliverable
usage: /agents [--count 2–4] <task>

name: open_app
description: open, launch, run or start an application, program or website such as the terminal, file manager, firefox, discord, vscode or youtube
usage: open <app name or website>, e.g. "open firefox", "open youtube.com"

name: time
description: tell the current time or date, what day it is
usage: "what time is it" or "what is the date"

name: companion_settings
description: change cursor visibility or the vision model
usage: show companion; hide companion; keep companion visible; use sonnet; use opus

usage: "press ctrl+t", "type <text>", "click <button name>", "copy", "paste", "undo", "new tab", "go back", "reload", "zoom in", "scroll down", "switch to <app>", "minimize", "maximize", "play/pause music", "next song", "go to workspace 2"; mouse uses screen coordinates and stays at its destination: "move mouse to 500, 300", "move mouse left 100", "mouse position", "click", "right click", "double click at 500, 300", "middle click", "scroll down 5", "scroll left 3", "drag from 100, 200 to 800, 600", "drag to 800, 600". name: deen
description: A supplication (adhkar) or a Qur'an verse
usage: /dua [morning|evening] · /ayah

name: deploy
description: Deploy a web app to Vercel
usage: /deploy <ability name | folder> · /deploy list

name: desktop
pattern: ^\s*(?:(?:hey\s+)?ultron[\s,]+)?(?:(?:yo|hey|please)\s+|can you\s+|could you\s+)?(?:(?:use|using) (?:the |your )?(?:mouse|screen|desktop|computer) to\s+.+|(?:control|operate|automate|use) (?:the |my )?(?:app|browser|chatgpt|firefox|chrome)\b.*|(?:find|search|fill|create|download|compare|organize|update|change) .+?\s+(?:and then|and|then)\s+(?:click|select|choose|find|open|save|download|create|type|change|set|search|fill)\b.+|(?:enable|disable|turn on|turn off|switch to) (?:the )?(?:dark|light) (?:mode|theme).*|(?:open|launch|switch to|go to) .+?\s+(?:and then|and|then)\s+.+)\s*$
description: complete a task in apps by looking at the screen and using the mouse and keyboard
usage: The original user task, e.g. "enable dark mode in this app", "open Firefox and find the downloads", "use the mouse to open settings". Use for multi-step app tasks, visible controls, or when one shortcut is insufficient. The agent inspects screenshots and acts until the requested result is verified.

name: generated
description: Run an ability you built with /build
usage: /<your ability command> [arguments]

name: hacker
description: Authorized read-only local project security checks
usage: /hacker --authorized <local-project-path>; /hacker tools

name: memory
pattern: ^\s*(remember\s+(that\s+)?)?(when|whenever|if)\s+i\s+say\s+(?:.+?)\s*,?\s+i\s+mean\s+(?:.+)$|^\s*remember\s+(that\s+)?(?:.+?)\s+(means|is short for|refers to|stands for)\s+(?:.+)$|^\s*(please\s+)?(remember|note|keep in mind|don'?t forget|do not forget)\b(\s+that)?[\s,:]+(?:.+)$|^\s*yes,?\s+forget\s+everything\b|^\s*(please\s+)?forget\s+(about\s+)?(?:.+)$|^\s*what\s+(do|did)\s+you\s+(remember|know)(\s+about\s+(?:.+?))?\s*\??$|^\s*(show|list)\s+(me\s+)?(my\s+|your\s+)?memor(y|ies)\b|^\s*what\s+(have|did)\s+you\s+learn(ed|t)?\b|\blearning\s+stats\b|^\s*how\s+much\s+have\s+you\s+learn
description: remember a fact, forget something, or say what you remember
usage: "remember that <fact>", "when I say <phrase> I mean <thing>", "forget <thing>", "what do you remember [about <topic>]"

name: time_report
description: report how much time I worked, studied or focused, show my stats or charts
usage: "how much did I work today|this week|this month", "show my week report", "label that as <label>"

name: screen
pattern: ^\s*(?:please\s+)?(?:explain (?:this|that|my|the)|what (?:is|does|am I|are) (?:this|that|on|these)|what(?:\'s| is) on my screen|point (?:at|to|out)|highlight\b|circle\b|draw (?:an? )?(?:arrow|circle|box)|tell me more|explain more|why (?:is|does) (?:it|that|this))
description: explain the current screen, answer follow-up questions, point or highlight a control
usage: explain this screen; point to <visible control>; highlight <visible area>; tell me more

name: screenshot
description: take a screenshot, capture or snap the screen
usage: "screenshot" (whole screen) or "screenshot region"

name: web_search
description: search the web or google, look up or find information online about a topic
usage: search [youtube|github|wikipedia|reddit] for <query>, e.g. "search youtube for lofi"

name: system
description: Today's quests, planning and logging in THE SYSTEM
usage: /today · /quest <objective> · /plan <objective> · /did <quest> · /log <kind> <values>

name: tasks
description: add tasks, show tasks, complete tasks or focus on a task
usage: add task <title>; show tasks; complete task <id>; reopen task <id>; focus task <id>

name: timer
description: set a timer or countdown for some minutes, or start a stopwatch
usage: "timer <n> min|s|h [for <label>]", "start stopwatch [for <label>]", "pause timer", "resume timer", "stop timer", "how much time is left on the timer"

name: volume
description: change the sound volume: turn it up or down, louder, quieter, mute or unmute
usage: "volume up 10", "volume down 10", "volume to 40%", "mute", "unmute"

name: workflow
pattern: (?:^\s*(?:(?:hey|yo)[, ]+)?(?:ultron[, ]+)?(?:(?:good|okay|ok|great|thanks)[,.!]?\s+)?(?:please\s+|can you\s+|could you\s+)?(?:research|do\s+(?:a\s+)?(?:search|research)|search|google|look\s+up|compare|find\s+(?:out|information|sources|reviews))\b)|(?:^\s*(?:(?:hey|yo)[, ]+)?(?:ultron[, ]+)?(?:(?:good|okay|ok|great|thanks)[,.!]?\s+)?(?:please\s+|can you\s+|could you\s+)?(?:teach|teatch|walk me through|guide me|show me how|help me (?:learn|understand)|explain (?:to me )?how)\b)|(?:^\s*(?:(?:hey|yo)[, ]+)?(?:ultron[, ]+)?(?:(?:good|okay|ok|great|thanks)[,.!]?\s+)?(?:please\s+|can you\s+|could you\s+)?(?:analy[sz]e|review (?:this|the)|study (?:this|the)|trade (?:for|with) me|paper[- ]trade)\b)|(?:\b(?:simora|trade\.padre\.gg|paper[- ]trad(?:e|es|ing))\b|^\s*(?:(?:please|go|start|can you|could you)\s+)*(?:trade|trading)\s+memecoins?\b)
description: research with sources, teach step by step, or analyze what is on screen
usage: research <question>; teach me how to <goal>; analyze this chart with me

name: workspace
description: Open the Ultron Workspace (chat, research, docs, email, notes, calendar)
usage: /workspace [notes|calendar|email|tasks|memory|gallery|cookbook|library] · /workspace status|restart|stop

name: none
pattern: ^\s*(hi|hello|hey|yo|sup|thanks|thank you|thx|good (morning|afternoon|evening|night))(\s+(there|ultron|man|bro))?\s*[.!]*\s*$|\b(who|what) are you\b|^\s*(what can you do|help)\s*\??\s*$
description: small talk or anything else
